name: @paigasus/app-shell
_comment_exports: ONE root export, and it is correct here. @paigasus/auth and @paigasus/discovery omit a root export because they have a server surface a client must not reach. This package has NO server surface: every file is client-reachable. Source-only (./src/*.ts), like every @paigasus/* package: a consuming Next app transpiles it through createNextConfig's SOURCE_ONLY_PACKAGES. tests/structure/source-shape.test.ts pins this map.
description: Shared console chrome for Paigasus zones: header, primary navigation, org/team switcher, user menu, breadcrumbs, and zone-safe cross-zone links.
